libs.note: BH-9799. bin/signal-env-install.sh <project> <NAME> (the value on stdin) writes one signal key into env/<project>.env under locks/harden-state.lock, between bin/harden-state.sh --release and --rearm (docs/KEY-ROTATION.md). Applied by the script with lib_env_apply signal-env-install.

knobs.note: How long the install waits for locks/harden-state.lock (flock -w) before it gives up with nothing written. An operator command, so a short wait. Out of range = 30. Read as ${SIGNAL_ENV_INSTALL_LOCK_WAIT_S:-30}.
